issue_context.title: Parquet filtering incorrect if left operand of binop is literal for `!=` filter
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl
p = Path("file.pq")
df = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "a": [1, 2, 3, None, 4, 5],
            "b": [None, None, 3, None, 4, 0],
        }
    )

df.write_parquet(p)

lf = pl.scan_parquet(p)

q_bad = lf.filter(pl.lit(0) != pl.col("a"))

q_good = lf.filter(pl.col("a") != pl.lit(0))

expect = df.filter(pl.lit(0) != pl.col("a"))

print("Expected")
print(expect)
print("Good")
print(q_good.collect())
print("Bad")
print(q_bad.collect())
```
Output:
```
Expected
shape: (5, 2)
┌─────┬──────┐
│ a   ┆ b    │
│ --- ┆ ---  │
│ i64 ┆ i64  │
╞═════╪══════╡
│ 1   ┆ null │
│ 2   ┆ null │
│ 3   ┆ 3    │
│ 4   ┆ 4    │
│ 5   ┆ 0    │
└─────┴──────┘
Good
shape: (5, 2)
┌─────┬──────┐
│ a   ┆ b    │
│ --- ┆ ---  │
│ i64 ┆ i64  │
╞═════╪══════╡
│ 1   ┆ null │
│ 2   ┆ null │
│ 3   ┆ 3    │
│ 4   ┆ 4    │
│ 5   ┆ 0    │
└─────┴──────┘
Bad
shape: (0, 2)
┌─────┬─────┐
│ a   ┆ b   │
│ --- ┆ --- │
│ i64 ┆ i64 │
╞═════╪═════╡
└─────┴─────┘
```


### Log output

```shell
dataframe filtered
parquet file must be read, statistics not sufficient for predicate.
parquet file can be skipped, the statistics were sufficient to apply the predicate.
```


### Issue description

If a literal is the left operand in a binop, parquet filters appear to be applied incorrectly.

### Expected behavior

Both orderings should produce the same result.
